cards.subject: The Hall of Blackhand
lines: Named for Rend's father — Blackhand the Destroyer, the first Warchief of the Horde. Rend claims the whole Horde by that bloodline and calls Thrall a usurper.
What he actually did to get it was go into business with a black dragon. Everything above this floor is the receipt.

cards.subject: One stair, one locked door
lines: Both halves of the Spire share a single entrance, and the upper one is behind a rune-sealed door partway up.
In 1.12 nobody gets through it without the seal on somebody's finger.
The door stayed keyed until patch 3.0.8, long after vanilla was over.

cards.subject: They are draining him in front of you
lines: In the Hall of Binding, Blackhand Incarcerators stand in a ring channelling bonds into a fire elemental.
He is Ragnaros's, taken in the Burning Steppes and brought up here.
Kill the warlocks holding him and he breaks loose and comes for the orcs and for you.

cards.subject: The whelp in the side room will talk
lines: Two orcs are torturing a small blue wyrmling. Free him and he explains the building.
"I watched in horror as they used my brothers and sisters in their experiments... From our essence would be created the chromatic flight."
The ones that failed went into the lava.

cards.subject: This is the room from the video
lines: The whelp-strewn egg chamber is where the most-watched moment in this game's history was filmed.
The guild was Pals For Life. The raid was counting whelps and planning when he charged.
The chicken was cooked during the planning.

cards.subject: The eggs are the encounter
lines: On the left side of the Rookery, ringed by eggs and dragonkin, sits an off-hand crystal.
Looting it summons five waves of guardians and hatchers, then Solakar Flamewreath.
The hatchers run between the eggs hatching whelps. Nothing in that room is scenery.

cards.subject: He is not always here, or in the same place
lines: A rare elite orc who spawns only sometimes, in one of two rooms: the armoursmith's, or the furnace.
Veterans check on the way in.
If he is in the furnace you will not reach him until after the arena.

cards.subject: The smith who welched on a demon
lines: Blackhand Legion Armorsmith — the orc who forges for Rend's army.
He sold his soul to a satyr, broke the deal and ran with an unforged rune-covered breastplate.
He is why blacksmiths come up here at all.

cards.subject: Step into the middle and the way out shuts
lines: The event triggers on entering the centre of the arena, and the southern gate closes behind you.
Anyone left outside it cannot help.
You can drop in from the western balcony. It does not save you.

cards.subject: Somebody is watching from the balcony
lines: Orcs spectate the arena from the western balcony, and so does a well-dressed human.
He is Nefarian wearing a person. When the waves fail him he sends Rend down himself.
After Rend dies he withdraws to Blackwing Lair, and you will meet him there.

cards.subject: Rend does not walk in. He flies in.
lines: Gyth is a chromatic drake — Nefarian's crossbreed, bred in this building — and Rend's personal mount.
You fight the drake first. He dismounts when it dies.
The Warchief of the true Horde rides the proof that he answers to a dragon.

cards.subject: Skin it and a gnome climbs out
lines: Skinning the corpse yields a special skinner, and pops out a gnome who had been eaten.
He is fine.
It is one of the very few jokes in the building.

cards.subject: The last room is not a boss room
lines: The final boss is not an orc either — a black dragonspawn titled Hand of Nefarian, flanked by two chromatic guards from the same experiment that made Gyth.
Kill him and a small chamber behind where he stood opens.
Put your hand on the brand in it. That mark is the door to Blackwing Lair.
